name: xpro-tweaks
description: X Pro（pro.x.com）のタイムラインをカラム単位で絞り込み、見た目を調整するブラウザ拡張

scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.store: npm run build && node render-store.mjs && node render-applied.mjs
scripts.package:source: if [ -z "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then mkdir -p web-ext-artifacts && git archive --format=zip -o "web-ext-artifacts/x_tweaks-$npm_package_version-source.zip" HEAD; else echo 'Commit first: the source package is built from HEAD'; exit 1; fi
